title: Vietnamese Rice Noodle Soup with Fermented Soft V Sterbottensost Cheese
description: A lacto-fermented soft V Sterbottensost cheese adaptation of the Vietnamese noodle soup, Pho, with a comforting bowl of rice noodles, savory beef broth, and creamy fermented cheese.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the star anise and cinnamon stick and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot.
Add the fish sauce (if using) and lime juice to the broth and stir to combine.
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
To assemble the soup, place a portion of the noodles in a bowl and ladle the hot broth over the top.
Top the soup with the shredded fermented soft V Sterbottensost cheese and serve immediately.
